emerging_technology: A tool-using generative AI assistant that retrieves equipment manuals, alarm histories and work orders and presents cited diagnostic leads for technician review.
intended_application: Triage repeat stoppages on a regulated drug packaging line
business_need: Find approved evidence faster while preserving traceability
users_stakeholders: Maintenance, Quality, validation, operations and IT/OT
capabilities_constraints: Controlled procedures, approved maintenance records, QA change control and authorized offline extracts
risk_consequence_context: Errors can affect product quality and record integrity. Quality owns production approval.
management_question: What evidence would justify moving from offline replay to a controlled production trial?
